frontMatter.value: Plain answers and clean prose wherever prose lands: a yes, a no, a number or I do not know first, the measurement in place of the adjective, a re-pitch when a reply did not land, the catalog of AI tells cut from every surface, and a document written in its one mode, sentence by sentence. Use when answering a question or reporting a result, when the owner says a reply did not land, before any prose lands, and when writing a document, a README, a PR description or a commit message; and whenever you are about to write "significantly", "much faster", "should work", "generally" or "nearly all".

passages.text: prose is the habit for the moment prose is about to land: a reply, a report, a review finding, a record's section, a commit message, a PR description, a document. This page owns the answer: what a question gets first, the measurement in place of the adjective, and the re-pitch when a reply did not land. Before any prose lands, cut the tells [tells.md](tells.md) catalogs; a document, a README, an RFC, a PR description or a commit message is written by [documents.md](documents.md) as well.

passages.text:
A known name, path, definition or explanation is answered with that answer itself and the repository evidence behind it, with no yes/no prefix and no invented uncertainty; a number stays required for a quantitative claim, not for every fact. The process is not the answer: report what is true, not the tools you are about to run, unless the owner asked how you work. Answer first, then the view: show-me decides what form the answer takes, after the answer. Where a claim enters a record, the measured number goes in with it. When the owner contradicts an answer you already gave, the reply is a fresh measurement, never the same sentence again: re-run the check, recorded where a change is open, quote the new outcome, and either name the benign difference that explains their result or correct the record plainly.

A yes/no, quantity or unknown-result question has four permitted answers.

The verify step is where verify-this's method now lives (S15), dense wording goes through the tells page, and the owner is the person the agent works for. Since J-93 S2 the front names greenline's homes and commands by their nouns, their paths and commands on the skill's references page.

passages.text:
## When a reply did not land

When the owner says a reply did not land ("wait, I don't understand where you've got to"), re-pitch it rather than repeat it. Give a little context first: where the work stands and what led there. Then say the point in simplified technical English, one thought per sentence with its articles and its verbs. Use the domain's words as `GLOSSARY.md` defines them, following `GLOSSARY-MAP.md` to the right glossary where the repository has more than one.
